prompt.project_info: Create a single perfectly composed 4:3 cinematic photograph of Shibuya Crossing immediately after a sudden summer shower, with a reflective time-layered city concept.
prompt.main_subject: A generic adult woman in a chrome puffer jacket kneels at the exact waterline and touches the puddle. Her reflection appears as a historical geisha reaching upward, with fingertips meeting at the surface. Keep all people generic and original, with no celebrity or public-figure likeness.
prompt.composition_elements: The entire street is covered in mirror-like rainwater. Above the waterline is hyper-real futuristic 2026 Shibuya with curved transparent OLED billboards, abstract floating holograms, salarymen in translucent raincoats and AR monocles, techwear pedestrians, glowing umbrella drones, cyan-magenta neon, and thousands of umbrellas. Below the waterline is a warm sepia 1926 Shibuya with low wooden shops, sliding doors, generic hand-painted kanji-style signs, rickshaws, early taxis, furisode kimono, haori-hakama, geta sandals, and gas lamps. At the boundary, concentric ripples become glowing pixels; a paper parasol becomes an umbrella drone, upward droplets become LED particles, and a salaryman sees an aged reflection. Everyone is frozen mid-step in shock and wonder.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cyan-magenta neon bleeds into wet asphalt above the waterline while warm sepia monochrome and soft gas-lamp glow define the historical reflection below. Add subtle volumetric god rays through rain mist, dramatic contrast, maximum emotional intensity, and a surreal yet physically coherent atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic Octane-style render, 4:3 aspect ratio, 8K-style reflection detail, anamorphic lens, perfect water physics, razor-sharp focal detail, controlled motion freeze, electric-neon-to-sepia color transition, no readable modern brand text, logos, or watermark.
